description: Cloudflare Cache Rules for CodexOne API, Session State, and Static Delivery

rules.description: Bypass edge and browser cache for all API requests and authenticated session cookies
Bypass edge cache for SPA document routing to guarantee fresh asset bundle hash resolution
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/") or (not http.request.uri.path contains "." and not http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/")

rules.description: Cache immutable hashed static assets for 1 year at edge and in browser
